name: taste-skill
description: Premium frontend taste system with adjustable variance, motion, and density controls for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Premium frontend taste system with controllable variance, motion, and density.
interface.longDescription: Use Taste Skill to build modern, premium-feeling web UIs with intentional typography, calibrated spacing, and cinematic motion. The bundle includes variants for redesigns, soft UI, minimalism, brutalism, GPT-tuned outputs, and stitch-compatible exports with adjustable variance, motion intensity, and visual density controls.
defaultPrompt: Use Taste Skill to design a premium landing page with bold typography and tasteful motion.
Switch to the minimalist-skill variant for a clean editorial layout with crisp borders.
Dial DESIGN_VARIANCE, MOTION_INTENSITY, and VISUAL_DENSITY to suit the product before coding.
